caption:
Starting on step one

"Start at the top." "Step one." The star hopped down to the bottom step and then climbed to the second.

Starting on the first step is slower for ten minutes and faster for the rest of the month.

For whoever starts on the first step instead of the hard one.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table and, at the right, a staircase of three blue steps with a gold star on the top one. A royal blue block figure with narrowed eyes says start at the top. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers start at step one, and the star hops down to the lowest step, then later climbs to the second. The blue one's eyes go wide and says ...ok. step two next. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me starting on step one.
